seo.title: Awrea Paris, women’s ready-to-wear made to order
seo.description: Awrea Paris: lace, draping and the gleam of gilding. The pieces of the Hypnotic Lace collection are made to order, without stock, by French artisans.

texte.accroche: Awrea Paris celebrates the meeting of contrasts.
texte.paragraphe: The delicacy of lace converses with the strength of jewellery, in a subtle balance between sensuality and character. Each piece is made to order, far from the logic of mass production. This choice lies at the heart of our vision: to produce only what is desired, with awareness and respect for the environment. There is no stock, only creations designed for the person who wears them. Our designs come to life in the hands of French artisans, guardians of a precious savoir-faire. We give essential attention to working conditions and to the recognition of these crafts, convinced that the beauty of a piece is also born of the ethics that accompany it.
chute: To wear Awrea is to choose an exceptional piece, designed to stand the test of time.
A creation that reveals the body instead of concealing it, that celebrates allure, confidence and the freedom to be oneself.

image.alt: The Aura bodysuit worn, black lace sequinned with gold, black draping knotted at the bust and long lace sleeves

cta.label: Read the story of the Maison

paragraphes: Delicacy meets strength. Elegance becomes a signature. A meeting between the finesse of lace, the sensuality of draping and the daring brilliance of gilding.
Through sculptural silhouettes and precious details, the “Hypnotic Lace” collection celebrates a femininity of contrasts: delicate, sensual and bold.

image.alt: The Aria dress worn, black lace bodice, gathered draping held by a gold ring and a black satin mermaid skirt

surDemande.titre: Your piece begins with your order
surDemande.texte: Nothing waits on a shelf. You choose the piece and your size, then French artisans make it for you: allow {hauts} for a bodysuit or a top, {robes} for a dress. In this way, the Maison makes only what is desired.

image.alt: The Sienna dress up close, black and gold lace at the high neck, the waist gathered to a point
